product.description: Spune-i copilului tău "noapte bună" într-o manieră diferită, citindu-i noua carte a psihologului Carl-Johan Forssen Ehrlin, autorul bestsellerului internațional Iepurașul care voia să adoarmă! Prin tehnicile de relaxare inovatoare, testate și aprobate de părinți, acest volum reprezintă o lectură vrăjită la finalul fiecărei zile.Lasă-ți copilul să fie legănat de povestea tractorașului Alex, cel mai obosit tractoraș din curtea din spate. Alex îl va duce într-o excursie relaxantă și amuzantă la țară, unde se vor întâlni cu prieteni ca Morcovul Toropit, Leon cel pe Jumătate Adormit sau merele somnoroase.Cartea conține materiale inedite, inclusiv idei de adormit copiii și răspunsurile autorului la întrebări frecvente referitoare la o mai bună rutină a somnului. Iar povestea va funcționa perfect atât în cazul somnului de după-amiază, cât și seara, la culcare.MĂRTURIILE PĂRINȚILOR"A fost super să putem testa o nouă poveste de noapte bună care funționează la fel de bine ca Iepurașul care voia să adoarmă!""Sunt uimită să-l văd pe fiul meu, care de obicei se liniștește greu înainte de culcare, cum adoarme rapid mulțumită acestei cărți. Incredibil!""A fost o minune să văd cum o carte poate avea un efect atât de bun asupra copiilor mei. Înainte dura ore întregi să-i pun la culcare, acum totul se rezolvă în 15 minute. Carl-Johan merită Premiul Nobel!"

# The Tractor That Wanted to Sleep by Litera

Unlock a peaceful night with *The Tractor That Wanted to Sleep*, a magical story designed to help your child find restful sleep in a unique and loving way. Written by Carl-Johan Forssen Ehrlin, the author of the internationally bestselling *The Hedgehog That Wanted to Sleep*, this book uses innovative relaxation techniques to guide children into deep slumber.

## A Relaxing Journey for Bedtime

Meet Alex, the sleepiest tractor in the backyard, who embarks on a relaxing and amusing adventure to the countryside. Alex meets charming friends like Pumpkin, Sleeping-Half Leon, and sleepy pears on his journey. This story provides a wonderful, calming narrative that makes winding down before bed an exciting experience rather than a chore.

This book is perfect for creating a soothing bedtime ritual. It offers delightful imagery and gentle themes that help transition children from busy play to calm rest. Whether used for an afternoon nap or a quiet evening story time, this book works perfectly for both daytime and nighttime routines.

## Sleep-Friendly Content & Insights

Beyond the enchanting story of Alex, this book is packed with valuable content designed by Carl-Johan Forssen Ehrlin. Inside, you will find unique material, including creative ideas for helping children fall asleep and helpful answers from the author regarding better sleep routines. This combination ensures that your child receives both a wonderful story and practical insights for healthy sleeping habits.

## What Parents Are Saying

Parents consistently praise this book for its effectiveness in promoting restful sleep:

*   "It was great to test a new bedtime story that works just as well as *The Hedgehog That Wanted to Sleep*!"
*   "I am amazed to see my son, who usually struggles to calm down before bed, fall asleep quickly thanks to this book. Incredible!"
*   "It was a miracle to see how a book can have such a good effect on my children. Before taking hours to put them to bed, now everything is resolved in 15 minutes. Carl-Johan deserves the Nobel Prize!"

***

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Who is the author of this book?**
A: The book is written by Carl-Johan Forssen Ehrlin, the author of the international bestseller *The Hedgehog That Wanted to Sleep*.

**Q: Is this book suitable for different times of the day?**
A: Yes, the story functions perfectly for both afternoon naps and bedtime stories.

**Q: What makes this book different from other bedtime stories?**
A: It incorporates innovative relaxation techniques and includes unique ideas and answers from the author on improving sleep routines.

***

**Price:** $44.99

Discover the magic of restful sleep today!
